Definition: from a presumed derivative of G2476 (like G4731); to set fast, i.e. (literally) to turn resolutely in a certain direction, or (figuratively) to confirm:--fix, (e-)stablish, stedfastly set, strengthen.
BiblicalUsage: To establish is to set fast, and the Lord does it for His people. When thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren, He tells Peter; Timothy is sent to establish the Thessalonians and comfort them concerning their faith; and James says, stablish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the establishing is the Lord's work in me before it is my work for others: He prayed for Peter, and Peter strengthens his brethren.
